title: Commercial Painting
summary: Full commercial painting — interior, exterior, line marking, graffiti removal and floor coatings.
intro: MrPaint provides a complete commercial painting service for offices, retail fitouts, body corporate, shopfronts and more — across Cairns and surrounds.
trust_line: After-hours and weekend work available so your business downtime is minimal.

sections.h: Commercial painting that respects your business
sections.p: Attention to detail matters, and so does staying out of your way. Having work completed by a professional team means a high-quality paint job that brings a tired space back to life — without disrupting trading hours. Our team can work outside regular hours to keep your downtime to a minimum.
Interior and exterior commercial painting, line marking, graffiti removal, floor coating systems, and ongoing maintenance painting for retail, hospitality, body corporate and office buildings.
MrPaint is fully insured and Work, Health and Safety compliant. We work to site rules, induction requirements, and any specific compliance your premises requires.
We assign a supervisor who reports directly to the business owner so our quality standards are met on every job, every time.

faqs.q: Can you work after hours so we don't have to close?
faqs.a: Yes. After-hours and weekend work is a regular part of our commercial offering. We'll plan the schedule around your operating hours.

faqs.q: Do you handle line marking and floor coatings?
faqs.a: Yes — line marking and protective floor coating systems are part of our commercial scope.

faqs.q: Are you set up for body corporate and strata work?
faqs.a: Yes. We work regularly with body corporate, agents and strata managers across Cairns.

title: Industrial Painting
summary: Industrial painting including epoxy finishes, 2-pacs, solvent-based coatings and protective systems.
intro: MrPaint covers the full industrial painting spectrum — warehouses, factories, plant and protective coatings — across Cairns and the wider region.
trust_line: Spray equipment, specialised coatings and a team trained in industrial finishes.

sections.p: Warehouse repaints, factory interiors and exteriors, structural steel, plant rooms, epoxy floor systems, 2-pac finishes and solvent-based protective coatings.

Industrial environments demand more than standard paint. We specify and apply protective coating systems — epoxy, 2-pac, solvent-borne — matched to the substrate and the conditions the surface will live in.
Fully insured, Work, Health and Safety compliant, and willing to work to your site's specific induction, PPE and compliance requirements.

faqs.q: Can you handle epoxy floor coatings?
faqs.a: Yes — epoxy floor systems for warehouses, plant rooms and workshops are part of our industrial scope.

faqs.q: Do you do 2-pac and solvent-based coatings?
faqs.a: Yes. We're set up for 2-pac finishes and solvent-borne protective coatings where the job requires it.

title: Roof Painting
summary: MrPaint is a local roof painting, family-run company servicing Cairns. Terracotta, concrete and metal roofs, gutters and downpipes. Get in touch with our friendly team.
intro: Looking for a painting company in Cairns that offers affordable roof painting services? Our team of experienced professionals are experts in painting roofs and will work diligently to ensure your project is completed to the highest standards.

faqs.a: Yes — water damage, smoke damage, vandalism or an unavoidable accident can all be handled with a high degree of expertise.

faqs.q: What types of painting do you do?
faqs.a: Roof, interior, commercial, residential, external or any other painting.

faqs.q: Does a fresh coat of paint improve the value of my home?
faqs.a: Creating a fresh new look for your property can increase its curb appeal and value if you are looking to sell. A neutral interior paint can make your property more appealing to a wider range of buyers, while a new exterior look can refresh your whole home. Painting both internally and externally has a great return on investment if you are selling. Keeping the roof clean can also help to improve the value of your home.

faqs.q: Can you help with lead paint removal?
faqs.a: Yes — our experienced team can handle lead paint removal and then re-paint with your choice of colours in a more health and environmentally friendly paint choice.
